content_of_post_to_comment:
this is going to be a controversial post, because i said i would document, not give advice.

i wake up at 7 and sleep at 11. i eat only food at home that mom prepares. i train every day. i've cut most people out. i'm learning a new skill.

all while working as a waiter, and honestly, i don't like it at all, but that's what i need to do right now.

this sounds boring, and it is boring, but imagine this: i used to chase girls, sleep at 4-6 in the morning, hang out with people without any perspective, no training, wasn't focused on learning any skill.

i thought that was fun, and that's what i was supposed to do at my age. but i was totally wrong, because all it gave me was dizziness, no purpose, i was weak.

and the cycle just kept going, day after day, year after year.

so if you're in the same place, ask yourself, is that what you want to do with your life? spending it on stuff that isn't beneficial at all, just because you think you're young and have time.

but we both know time isn't unlimited. it's running out, and we're getting older day after day.

so before spending another day on stuff that doesn't make you better, ask yourself: what am i even doing.

that's all i had for today, see you tomorrow.
